FREE BUSINESS GUIDE / 05

Google Business Profile

Google Business Profile helps eligible businesses be found locally. Eligibility comes first; online-only businesses generally do not qualify.

5 lessonsStep-by-step tutorialNo account needed

THE FIELD GUIDE / 05
05
Google Business ProfileBIZZINTEL · KEEP BUILDING
How to use this guide

Read one lesson, complete the action in your business, and keep the result somewhere you can find it. The examples are illustrations, not claims about real customers.

LESSON 01 / 05

Check eligibility

Wrong eligibility claims can lead to suspension.

What to do

  1. Confirm the business has eligible in-person customer contact.
  2. Differentiate storefront, service-area, hybrid and online-only.
  3. Read Google's current eligibility policies before taking action.
EXAMPLE / ILLUSTRATIVE

Example to adapt: describe what a real customer would do or see at this step. Use actual facts for your business.

AVOID THIS

Registering online-only brands or virtual offices as staffed locations.

LESSON 02 / 05

Claim or create the profile

Avoid duplicates and ownership confusion.

What to do

  1. Search for an existing listing before creating one, use the correct Google account and follow Google's setup flow.
  2. Record the result in your workbook.
  3. Verify important details before treating the task as finished.

LESSON 03 / 05

Complete the business details

Accuracy improves trust and customer contact.

What to do

  1. Choose the closest accurate primary category.
  2. Use real hours, website, phone and location/service areas.
  3. Write a short plain-language description without keyword stuffing.

LESSON 04 / 05

Verify and add real media

Verification and authentic photos are central to a usable listing.

What to do

  1. Use the verification method Google offers.
  2. Add only real photos that represent actual operations.
  3. Check service-area display rules and hide home address where appropriate.

LESSON 05 / 05

Create a maintenance habit

Profiles go stale when hours, services or links change.

What to do

  1. Correct holiday hours and booking links promptly.
  2. Respond respectfully to genuine reviews.
  3. Track enquiries and profile actions; never buy or fabricate reviews.
